the Oncotype DX is the most extensively studied assay with the most data supporting its use in the clinical setting, and it has been approved for use in the adjuvant setting by the US Food and Drug Administration. However
the Oncotype Dx is the only assay that has established clinical utility for the indication of adjuvant systemic chemotherapy.

gene expression assays have been shown to be useful in guiding adjuvant treatment decisions.
the Oncotype DX® assay is indicated in ER-positive, HER2-negative node-negative breast cancer to help determine which patients will benefit from chemotherapy.
